title: KP14 3c blueprint, second pass: loading c z~^2 = [0.0, 0.35, 0.0875, 0.0875, 0.35] on a cash-flow-level ladder [1.0, 0.38, 0.74, 0.92, 0.58] (a pure scale; solved so the types sit 0.7 log-size apart after the exposure's 14 b), exact compensation, price 2.5
question: On the one 3c blueprint (loading c z~^2 on a scale ladder, both ends exposed), is the true weight non-monotone in the characteristic and the fair gap above 0.02?
notes:
2026-11-11: second pass on the 3c blueprint ladders. Measured on bvyuq / vyuq (3 seeds): d log mve = 1.03 log scale + 0.60 b (BGN),
6.52 log level + 14.0 b (KP14). The first-pass ladders left the small exposed type at the size of the next unexposed type (BGN
ranks 0.32 = 0.32; KP14 0.81 > 0.78). Here the ladder is solved so the five types sit at log-size targets (-0.92, -0.46, 0, 0.46,

(0.35, 0.0875, 0, 0.0875, 0.35), compensated at y = 0; prices 2.5 and 3.5.
